name: smwgraphics-mega-man-bass-tengu-man
title: Mega Man & Bass - Tengu Man
description:
The gorgeous city in the sky background, from Mega Man & Bass, also know as Rockman & Forte. Perfect fit for sky levels. This rip was part of my C3 Graphic Ripping Showcase.

Optimizations were made. The background loops even better. The gfx itself uses less space than before. Better palette allocation.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
